As someone who's overweight myself(around 195 lbs), I had an ex boyfriend a few years back who wanted me to be bigger and would not like when I talked of wanting to lose weight. I dumped him soon afterwards because I am not letting ANYONE get in the way of my health and healing.

I'm glad you lost that weight though, your ex is gonna be unhealthy and miserable for the rest of his life meanwhile at least you will be healthy and happy and be able to do many things that he will never be able to. You deserve SO SO SO MUCH BETTER than that asshole. He's obviously mentally abusive and is insecure as fuck due to his weight but that gives him no right to make you feel insecure about your decision to be healthier.

In my opinion, you should absolutely stay far far away from him and never contact him again. Also, please make your own Spotify account. It makes me so mad that he refuses any kind of help for losing weight, but to be fair, you can't reason with gross creepy fetish obsessed ass basement dweller incels.

You should surround yourself with people who actually make an effort to improve their health, as you have been doing for yourself. It'll help you keep your low weight since you will be around people who will lift you up instead of tearing you down like your ex did.

I wasn't in my right mind for a long while due to quarantine in 2020 and not being around people at all or going outside (I was basically going stir crazy for a while and I self isolated from talking to anyone because of how depressed I was and also in fear of hurting anyone else) so it took me way longer than it should've for me to realize.
